vendor_id: vendor_veriff
vendor_name: Veriff
vendor_type: identity_verification
retrieved_at: 2026-10-03

public_resources:
- https://www.veriff.com/product/liveness
- https://devdocs.veriff.com/docs/biometric-liveness
- https://developers.veriff.com/
- https://www.veriff.com/trust-center
- https://help.veriff.com/s/article/What-fraud-prevention-mechanisms-does-Veriff-have-in-place

key_components:

liveness_detection:
  approach: passive
  description: Users submit a selfie without performing specific actions. System analyzes biometric signals, face texture, and movements.
  anti_spoofing: Claims ISO/IEC 30107-3 PAD compliance via iBeta testing
  detects: masks, screens, deepfakes, photos, pre-recorded video

document_verification:
  ocr: Yes, extracts data from MRZ, visible fields, barcodes, chips
  authenticity_checks: Computer vision for tampering, font mismatches, inconsistent data
  template_matching: Yes, compares against genuine document templates
  security_features: Claims to detect holograms, UV marks, microprinting via image analysis
  face_matching: Compares document photo to liveness selfie

device_and_session:
  device_fingerprinting: Yes, collects device, browser, network signals
  session_validation: Session-based via POST /v1/sessions endpoint
  webhook_support: Yes, for real-time status updates
  collected_data: Can upload additional attributes via /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/collected-data

fraud_controls:
  face_comparison: Machine and human review
  background_detection: Video noise and background validation
  hybrid_flagging: Machine-assisted with human oversight
  pep_sanctions: Yes, watchlist and AIM checks
  anomaly_detection: Yes, pattern and behavioral analysis

compliance:
  certifications: ISO/IEC 27001, SOC2 Type II, FIDO Document Authenticity, GDPR
  standards: ISO/IEC 30107-3 PAD Level 2

notes: 
- Passive liveness is the primary approach (no active challenge prompts required)
- Claims comprehensive anti-spoofing but specific robustness to degraded media not publicly detailed
- Document verification includes hologram detection via image analysis
- Multi-layer fraud detection but composition and weighting not disclosed
